note: Faction temperaments: which notoriety titles each faction admires, despises or fears, its lines, and what its barmen give an admired holder. Hand-edited; gen_title_temperaments.py turns it into content/x_title_temperaments.json (Meitou only). {title} is the title's name, {Title} the same capitalised at the start of a sentence. Design: modgen/TITLES_BY_FACTION.md.

admire: Okran sees honest work. {Title}, they call you.
{Title}. The Nation needs more of your kind.
Okran's light on you, {title}.
despise: {Title}. Okran has a place for you, and it burns.
We don't deal with your kind here.
Walk on, {title}. Nobody here owes you anything.
fear: Stand aside. That one killed a Lord.
gift_line: Eat. The faithful look after their own.

admire: {Title}. That name was earned standing up.
A warrior's name, {title}. Good.
They say you don't stay down. Respect.
despise: {Title}. There's no honour in that name.
We fight the standing. Remember it.
Keep your kind of work away from us.

admire: {Title}. Useful people are always welcome.
The lords pay for names like yours, {title}.
Ah. {Title}. Good for business.
despise: We have nothing for your kind.
fear: Don't stare. Not at that one.
The guards know your name, {title}. Behave.
gift_line: On the house. Remember who poured it.

admire: {Title}. The roads are safer with you on them.
Good for trade, people like you.
The Guild remembers its friends, {title}.
despise: The Guild has no work for you.
fear: {Title}. Keep your hands where I can see them.
Nobody wants trouble. Least of all with you.
gift_line: On the house. Keep the roads clear.

admire: {Title}. You've seen more of the old world than most.
Good hands, {title}. Rare.
A name worth having out here.
gift_line: Take these. The ruins don't feed anyone.

admire: {Title}. Every chain you break counts.
Good work out there, {title}.
They whisper your name in the cages.
{Title}. The Nation bleeds because of you.
Good. Every Paladin you drop is one less.
Welcome, {title}. Truly.
gift_line: Eat. You fight their war for us.

admire: {Title}. You've been around.
Professionals know professionals.
Good name to have, {title}.
{Title}. You walk like one of us.
The roads know your feet, {title}. So do we.
Sit, {title}. A walker always has a place at our fire.
fear: That one leaves bodies on every road. Let them pass.

admire: {Title}. You've walked further than most.
The road knows you, {title}.
{Title}. Quiet work. We like that.
Our kind of business, {title}.
{Title}. Hush says your hands mend. Good hands.
Mender. {Title}. Little ones remember who mends.
{Title}. Come in. Mending hands welcome at gate.
despise: {Title}. You finish dhe fallen. Not here. Never here.
Lie down and live, Hush says. You not let dhem, {title}.
Walk on, {title}. Gate closed to you.
fear: {Title}. Killer of eaters. We were eaters once. Do not look at us.

admire: {Title}! Good cutter! /CANNIBALHA/!
Cutter-meat. {Title}. We like. Still eat you.
{Title}. Many pieces. Good kitchen hands.
despise: {Title}. No eat. No talk. Only kill.
Dhat one, {title}. Pot wait long time for dhat one.
fear: {Title}... Even Hunger run from dhat one.
